text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
There are still things I'm worried about, 
but even as the new me, I was able to get 
solid results! I'm sure I can keep getting 
stronger.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"So after talking it over with Trainer, we 
decided to aim for the Yomiuri Milers Cup 
next, but..."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
If I keep racking up successes in races, 
the URA might even give you an award, 
Trainer! Ehehe, I've got a new dream 
now...♪

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Zephyr-san will be in the next race with 
me too. She said she's challenging the 
wall of distance, but... She seemed to be 
having a bit of a hard time, and it 
worries me—
